description.value:
Frequency 1/round

A quick half-step and re-grip converts what would be your third, heavily-penalized attack of the turn into a fresh Strike against your current Mark only, with your multiple attack penalty on it reduced by 2 instead of the usual amount.

cinderfall.incomplete: Blocked on the Mark predicate, and independently: there's no rule element that "resets" or overrides the engine's own per-turn multiple-attack-penalty counter for a single named Strike — MAP tracking is internal turn-sequence state, not actor data a rule element can rewrite mid-turn for one attack only. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
